messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Query: Distance 3.5 for Win 2000
parts:
Dear Distance users,

Query: A few of you have downloaded a test version of Distance 3.5 that is
designed to install under Windows 2000. The test installation is called
D35SetupTest.exe. If anyone has had trouble running analyses using that
build, could they please contact me?

I know of two people so far who have had trouble (Harald and Debbie, e.g.,
see below), but I cannot reproduce the problem on a test machine running
Windows 2000 Pro here at St Andrews.

Thanks,

- Len Thomas

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland


-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Date: Thu, 12 Oct 2000 14:46:11 -0600
From: Debbie Devore
To: dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk

I was sent the Windows 2000 version of Distance 3.5 this past Summer. When
trying to run an analysis (with all different types of data) on a Windows
2000 comptuer, I receive the following error:

"Error: Distance failed to start the analysis engine. Analysis aborted."

I loaded the same Windows 2000 version on my NT 4.0 machine and received the
same error. I then uninstalled the Windows 2000 version and installed the
older version of Distance 3.5 for Windows and the analysis ran fine. I think
there is something in the Windows 2000 version that is causing the problem.
The only fix I could find on your web site did not work. We converted our
entire PC labs to Windows 2000 over the Summer and I have an instructor who
needs to teach Distance next week. Is there any way there could be a rush
put on this to fix the problem or at least look into it?

Thanks for any help.

Debbie Devore
Colorado State University
College of Natural Resources
Computing Labs Manager
-----------------------------------------------------------------------


--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland KY16 9SS

email: dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk
RUWPA home page: http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk
